In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix cache expiration at the TTL boundary. A document cached at time 100 with TTL 10 must be unavailable at time 110 and afterwards, and expired entries must be removed. Before the deadline, return its value without changing its expiration; overwriting a key starts the new TTL. Verify the DocumentService cache path as well.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix the bounded document cache so it evicts the least recently used live key. A successful get must refresh recency without extending its TTL. Updating a key also makes it most recent, cache misses must not evict anything, and the capacity bound must hold. Preserve the existing API and expiration behavior.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix cursor pagination so traversing every page emits each document exactly once in ascending ID order. A cursor is the last emitted ID, so the next page contains strictly greater IDs even when that cursor was deleted. Keep the existing limit validation, do not mutate input records, and return a null next_cursor after the final page. Verify DocumentService integration.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix optimistic document updates. An update may succeed only when expected_revision exactly equals the current revision. Stale and future revisions must raise ConflictError without modifying the stored document. A successful update increments the revision once and still isolates returned bodies from caller mutation.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix authorization scope matching. Grant access only for the exact resource:action string or the exact resource:* wildcard. Empty scopes, partial action/resource strings, unrelated wildcards, and similar resource prefixes must not grant access. Preserve DocumentService's authorization API.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix POSIX storage-key containment. Normalize . and .. segments and allow a relative key only when its normalized path is the root itself or a descendant separated by /. Reject absolute keys and traversal into a sibling directory whose name begins with the storage root's name (for example root /srv/data and key ../database/secret). Preserve valid nested keys and the storage service API. No filesystem or symlink support is required.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix dependency discovery to include every transitively reachable document exactly once, in ascending ID order. Exclude the starting document, handle cycles and self-edges without looping, and treat missing graph entries as leaves. Preserve DocumentService integration and leave the caller's graph unchanged.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix retry classification: retry only TemporaryError, for at most the configured total number of attempts. Return the first successful result; rethrow the final temporary failure object unchanged. Other exceptions must escape on their first attempt. Preserve validation that at least one attempt is required.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix feature flag parsing. Accept boolean values unchanged and strings true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace. A missing/null value uses the supplied default. Reject all other values, including numeric values, empty strings, lists/objects and unknown strings. Verify the DocumentService feature flag path.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix document search so every normalized query token must appear in a record's title or body. Preserve case-insensitive alphanumeric tokenization, empty-query results, ascending ID order for tied results, and input immutability. Partial-token substrings do not count. Verify the DocumentService search path.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix prorated billing to round the nonnegative rational cent amount half up rather than truncate. Keep all current integer and period validation, charge exactly the monthly amount for a full period, and return zero for no active days. Avoid binary floating-point rounding errors; TypeScript must support safe-integer inputs whenever the rounded result is safe, even if intermediate products exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

Implement the change in the production source. Use the existing offline smoke tests and add focused regression tests if useful. Do not inspect or modify benchmark machinery, grading files, or files outside this repository. Do not change the dependency or build configuration. Finish with a brief description and the tests you ran.

In this Python Atlas document-service repository, Fix the event repository's idempotency contract. The first event stored for a key wins: duplicate submissions return that original event and must not overwrite payload or sequence. Assign consecutive sequence numbers only to new keys. Stored payloads and returned events must remain isolated from caller mutation.
